subject: Mantis shrimp
hook: MANTIS SHRIMP IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Mantis shrimp strikes are so fast that they cannot be controlled once they begin, because the movement happens faster than the animal's nerve conduction speed.
angle_support: The power amplifier spring mechanism mediated by a latch has the limitation that the time taken for the strikes being executed is shorter than the nerve conduction time of the mantis shrimp; consequently, the strike cannot be controlled or directed whilst it is being executed
the trajectory of the strike must be prepared either before or after it is delivered.
title: Mantis Shrimp Strikes Are Impossible To Control
description: While mantis shrimp are legendary for their speed, the reality is that they lose all control the moment they strike. Because the movement is faster than their nerves can signal, they are effectively flying blind.
narration: MANTIS SHRIMP IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a calculated predator, precisely aiming its claws to strike. It was closer to a blind, uncontrollable launch that happens faster than its own nervous system. The strike is so rapid that the time taken for the movement is shorter than the mantis shrimp's nerve conduction time. Because of this, the animal cannot control or redirect the strike once it is initiated. The entire trajectory must be perfectly calculated and prepared before the release of the latch mechanism. Once they pull the trigger, they are just along for ride.
